2117804038418809215.en_summary: A 76-year stat with zero misses is about to kick in. Since 1950 the S&P 500 has been higher 12 months after every single midterm election. 19 for 19. Average gain about 16%. Even ugly years like 2018 still finished next 12 months up. Midterm year lows usually print before the election. Uncertainty clears and money floods back. Watching $NVDA above 212, $MU back above 900, $SNDK back above 1200, $NBIS back above 170, $AMD back above 500. $SMH holding 525 with $QQQ above 700 and $SPX above 7630. If hold, push higher; if not, SPX towards 7300 and QQQ towards 660. Overall next 12 months should be higher.
2117804038418809215.zh_summary: 一個76年零失誤的統計即將啟動。自1950年以來，標普500在每次中期選舉後12個月都更高。19次中的19次。平均漲幅約16%。即使如2018年等糟糕年份，接下來12個月仍上漲。中期年低點通常在選舉前出現。不確定性清除後資金回流。觀察NVDA高於212，MU回到900以上，SNDK回到1200以上，NBIS回到170以上，AMD回到500以上。SMH守住525，QQQ高於700，SPX高於7630。若守住則推高；否則SPX向7300，QQQ向660。整體未來12個月應更高。
